C-22.IntentSummary: Split View container: mirror one mode beside the other, read-only sync, divider ratio persisted, Cmd+\ per-tab toggle. Four-corner review protocol; corner matrix drives both tests and review scope.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: splitView.vue renders both mode components; editable side follows current mode; mirror is a second instance flagged read-only via existing component props/patching the minimum; divider drag updates ratio; ratio + enabled saved to prefs (per-window file as today's window-state).

Single source of truth: the active pane's markdown string; mirror re-renders on change with 150ms debounce; mirror NEVER writes to store; typing latency in editable pane unchanged (no sync work on keystroke path beyond a dirty flag).
view.split-view command toggles for CURRENT tab; Cmd+\ bound via existing keybinding registry; description strings en/ru/…; command palette picks it up automatically (registry).

Playwright: boot → toggle split → assert two panes → edit source → mirror content changes within 300ms → reload → split+ratio restored. Probes: light/dark screenshots into plan ReviewLog. grace lint 0; graph/verification entries registered.

Verification.Command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/split-view.spec.ts && grace lint --path . --assertions current

Corner.Situation: Toggle split while a document has unsaved changes / dirty dot
Corner.Expected: content preserved bit-identical; dirty state untouched; no autosave trigger

Corner.Situation: Split ON, then mode toggle (Cmd+Alt+S) in editable pane
Corner.Expected: panes swap editability; editable cursor position preserved per its own surface; no focus theft

Corner.Situation: Tab switch: tab A split-on ratio 30%, tab B split-off
Corner.Expected: each tab restores its own state on return; no cross-tab leakage
mirror updates coalesce (≤2 re-renders per burst); editable pane keystroke latency unchanged (no main-thread stall > 16ms)

Corner.Situation: Live-reload external edit while split (watcher fires)
Corner.Expected: both panes update per existing reload semantics; cursor-preservation logic applies to the EDITABLE pane only
split collapses to single-pane (mode toggle remains); re-expanding restores ratio; no clipped half-panes
split+ratio restored via prefs; failure to read prefs defaults split-off (fail-open)
operate on the document as today (single-model); no pane duplication in output
mirror defers heavy renders (existing lazy semantics); no double network/local resource fetch
clamped at 10/90; no zero-width pane or divider loss

Checks.Check: MODULE_CONTRACT/MAP present and true for splitView.vue
Corners C-1..C-3, C-7 behaviour matches Expected verbatim
no writes from mirror; single document model (assert store usage)
no new IPC, no new permissions/capabilities, no network
mirror renders through the same sanitization paths (no raw-html bypass)
public-repo hygiene: no secrets, no signing material near the change
Corners C-2, C-6, C-10 feel right (no focus theft, no lost divider)
guide page updated (site/docs) with Cmd+\ and corner behaviors
i18n strings complete; menu/palette consistency test updated
Corners C-4, C-9: burst coalescing proven; keystroke path unchanged
RAM delta with split-on idle < 25MB on the 10k-line fixture
no new dependencies; bundle delta ≤ 3KB gz
